verdict.line: You lose if you let Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow you into a wall for his E knockup; you win every trade you take with W (Hallowed Mist) and R (Needlework) doing the work instead of your face.

brief.thesis: Ornn's whole kit is built around one setup: slow with Q (Volcanic Rupture, 800 range), then either charge E (Searing Charge, 450 range) into terrain for a knockup, or just let W (Bellows Breath) apply Brittle on the final gout. Gwen has no dash that out-ranges his Q, but she has the only tool in the lane that makes positioning irrelevant — W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untargetable by anything outside it — plus an R (Needlework, 1200 range) that outranges every damaging tool Ornn has. The lane is decided by whether you respect his cooldowns or feed him a wall.

theirWindow.when: Q lands and you're near terrain
theirWindow.what: He's going to charge E (Searing Charge) into the nearest wall for the shockwave knockup. Walk away from walls the moment you're slowed, or drop W (Hallowed Mist) immediately so his follow-up whiffs.

yourWindow.when: his Q and E are both down
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Skip 'n Slash, 400 range), auto, and stack Q (Snip Snip!) snips. If you land a hit during E's buff window the cooldown partially refunds, so you can chain in and out before his 9-7s Q timer resets.

start.why: 52.3% win rate over 1,346 games and 91% pick rate — the mana and sustain let you contest trades through his Q poke without running oom.

boots.why: 55.6% win rate over 293 games. Ornn's combo is three separate CC applications (Q slow, E knockup, W/R Brittle) — tenacity directly shortens how long you're locked down for his follow-up.

core.why: Standard first component in the highest-sample build path (51.9% WR, 21.7% pick) — gives the early AP and mana you need to keep spamming Q.
Bonus damage to weakened targets lines up with A Thousand Cuts dropping enemy health, snowballing your trades.
Completes the 51.9% WR path — raw AP scaling turns Q/R poke into real kill pressure by mid game.

runes.keystoneWhy: This matchup is won through repeated short trades, not one burst window — Conqueror's stacking adaptive force and healing keeps you ahead through extended Q-poke exchanges and scales into Ornn's tankiness.

summoners.why: 52.1% win rate over 22.9% pick rate, the highest-sample combo. Teleport lets you reset with full items and level advantage since Ornn can forge items anywhere and won't punish your recalls the way a roaming laner would.

playing.title: Respect the 800-range Q
playing.detail: Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) slows and has an 9-7s cooldown with an 800 range — don't stand in a straight line he can hit through minions, especially before you have W online at level 3-5.

playing.title: Drop W the instant he commits
playing.detail: W (Hallowed Mist) makes you untargetable by anything outside it. The moment Ornn charges Q or starts his E, pop it so his cooldown burns for nothing.

playing.title: Never stand near walls when his E is up
playing.detail: Ornn's E (Searing Charge, 450 range) only knocks up and deals bonus damage if he collides with terrain mid-charge. Fight in open lane space when it's available.

playing.title: Chain E for free trades
playing.detail: E (Skip 'n Slash) dashes and buffs attack speed/range/on-hit damage; landing a hit during that window partially refunds the cooldown. Dash in, auto, and bail before his next Q.

playing.title: Poke with R the second it's up
playing.detail: R (Needlework, 1200 range) outranges everything Ornn can throw back — Q is 800, E is 450. Chip him from behind minions and stack A Thousand Cuts for free sustain.

playing.title: Watch for his R elemental
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God travels toward Ornn and is visible well before impact. If it's summoned near you, disengage rather than contest — getting run over then recast-knocked-up is a dead trade.

playing.title: Spam Q in extended fights
playing.detail: Snip Snip! cools down to as low as 3.5s and deals true damage to the center target — in a drawn-out skirmish this is your highest sustained DPS and healing source.
